comment: Note: This is lightweight in order to avoid a full SIP stack import in frameworks/base.

variables.name: SIP_REQUEST_METHODS
variables.comment: Request-Line = Method SP Request-URI SP SIP-Version CRLF

variables.name: SIP_VERSION_2
variables.comment: Status-Line = SIP-Version SP Status-Code SP Reason-Phrase CRLF

variables.name: SUBHEADER_VALUE_SEPARATOR
variables.comment: example "v: XX1;branch=YY1,XX2;branch=YY2". This needs to be treated as two "v:" headers.

variables.name: PARAM_SEPARATOR
variables.comment: SIP header parameters have the format ";paramName=paramValue"

variables.name: VIA_SIP_HEADER_KEY_COMPACT
variables.comment: compact form of the via header key

variables.name: CALL_ID_SIP_HEADER_KEY_COMPACT
variables.comment: compact form of the call-id header key

variables.name: FROM_HEADER_KEY_COMPACT
variables.comment: compact form of the from header key

variables.name: TO_HEADER_KEY_COMPACT
variables.comment: compact form of the to header key

variables.name: TAG_PARAM_KEY
variables.comment: The tag parameter found in both the from and to headers

variables.name: ACCEPT_CONTACT_HEADER_KEY_COMPACT
variables.comment: compact form of the accept-contact header key

methods.name: public static boolean isSipRequest(String startLine)
methods.comment:
* @return true if the SIP message start line is considered a request (based on known request
     * methods).

methods.name: public static boolean isSipResponse(String startLine)
methods.comment: * @return true if the SIP message start line is considered a response.

methods.name: public static String getTransactionId(String headerString)
methods.comment:
* Return the via branch parameter, which is used to identify the transaction ID (request and
     * response pair) in a SIP transaction.
     * @param headerString The string containing the headers of the SIP message.

methods.name: private static String getParameterValue(String headerValue, String parameterKey)
methods.comment:
* Search a header's value for a specific parameter.
     * @param headerValue The header key's value.
     * @param parameterKey The parameter key we are looking for.
     * @return The value associated with the specified parameter key or {@link null} if that key is
     * not found.

methods.name: public static String getCallId(String headerString)
methods.comment:
* Return the call-id header key's associated value.
     * @param headerString The string containing the headers of the SIP message.

methods.name: public static String getFromTag(String headerString)
methods.comment: * @return Return the from header's tag parameter or {@code null} if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: public static String getToTag(String headerString)
methods.comment: * @return Return the to header's tag parameter or {@code null} if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: public static String[] splitStartLineAndVerify(String startLine)
methods.comment:
* Validate that the start line is correct and split into its three segments.
     * @param startLine The start line to verify and split.
     * @return The split start line, which will always have three segments.

methods.name: public static Set<String> getAcceptContactFeatureTags(String headerString)
methods.comment: * @return All feature tags starting with "+" in the Accept-Contact header.

methods.name: private static String[] splitParamValue(String paramValue)
methods.comment:
* Takes a string such as "\"a,b,c,d\"" and splits it by "," into a String array of
     * [\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"d\"]

methods.name: public static List<Pair<String, String>> parseHeaders(String headerString, boolean stopAtFirstMatch, String... matchingHeaderKeys)
methods.comment:
* Parse a String representation of the Header portion of the SIP Message and re-structure it
     * into a List of key->value pairs representing each header in the order that they appeared in
     * the message.
     *
     * @param headerString The raw string containing all headers
     * @param stopAtFirstMatch Return early when the first match is found from matching header keys.
     * @param matchingHeaderKeys An optional list of Strings containing header keys that should be
     *                           returned if they exist. If none exist, all keys will be returned.
     *                           (This is internally an equalsIgnoreMatch comparison).
     * @return the matched header keys and values.

methodNames: private static String getParameterValue(String headerValue, String parameterKey)
public static List<Pair<String, String>> parseHeaders(String headerString, boolean stopAtFirstMatch, String... matchingHeaderKeys)
